title: mistralrs runner errors
description: The mistralrs runner's own error codes, beyond the runner contract's. They fill the contract's runnerErrors extension point. Each refuses run/start, so no run starts and no model is loaded.

oneOf.description: The run/start options hold a key the runner doesn't define, such as model, which is the runtime's.
An option's value has the wrong shape. The fix names what is valid.
run/start names no runtime, so the runner has no model. The fix says to name the runtime mistralrs for the actor.

The runtime has an endpoint or a credential, which an in-process runtime never has: the runner loads its model in its own process and talks to no service. A credential's value isn't read, and isn't in the error.

The run's model isn't the absolute path of a GGUF file: it's a relative path or a model's name, or the file doesn't start with the GGUF signature. Nothing is fetched. The fix names TROUPE_RUNTIME_MISTRALRS_MODEL.
No file is at the run's model's path, or it can't be read. The fix names TROUPE_RUNTIME_MISTRALRS_MODEL.

On macOS, the engine can't compile its Metal kernels under the Python the runner runs in, which depends on the SDK that Python was built with: Homebrew's Pythons on macOS 27 and python.org's 3.12 fail, and uv-managed Pythons work. The fix says to install troupe on a uv-managed Python.

python.description: The Python the runner runs in: sys.executable.

where.description: Where the problem is, such as options.maxTurns or runtime.endpoint.

model.description: The model, as the run's runtime gave it.
